contract:
DECISIONS (user, issue #6, 2026-11-17):
- Videos are public GitHub Release assets on this repo (tag `demos`, asset demo-YYYY-MM-DD.mp4, one per day, all kept; a manual run replaces today's under the same name). The snapshot records the asset URL.
- Failure step: <step> is taken word for word from chess-tutor's error text `demo stopped at <step>: <reason>`. Known steps today: "the tutor's question", "Hint", "Show me". Other chess-tutor failures (Playwright expect timeouts, "no scripted or fallback move is legal after ...", "no move losing >= 250 cp ...") carry no step -> step null. Failures in the dashboard's own steps (wait, upload) -> step null. Store the step raw; the page drops a leading "the " for display, not you.
- The technical reason stays in the run log; it is NOT stored in the snapshot.

LIVE HEALTH (measured 2026-11-17, GET https://chess-tutor-hyb9.onrender.com/api/health): {"ok":true,"engine":"ready","commit":"de786d065b37d71837993a520e1bb57eee7cecba"}. Note: at that moment chess-tutor main head was 621270d (not yet live), so "newest commit on main" is NOT a safe target; Render's buildFilter skips docs-only commits entirely, so they never go live.

WAIT RULE (demo-wait): poll every DEMO_POLL_SECONDS (default 20) up to DEMO_WAIT_MINUTES (default 20). App URL = APP_URL if non-empty (an unset Actions variable arrives as ""), else the Render service's serviceDetails.url (as status.ts does). Ready when: health returns 2xx with ok === true and a 40-hex commit, AND (if RENDER_API_KEY is set) the newest Render deploy (GET /v1/services/{id}/deploys?limit=1, service found by name RENDER_SERVICE_NAME default "chess-tutor", like status.ts) is not in progress (in progress = created, queued, build_in_progress, update_in_progress, pre_deploy_in_progress), and if that newest deploy's status is "live", the health commit equals its commit.id. If the newest deploy failed/canceled, the old version is still serving: accept the health commit. Without RENDER_API_KEY: accept the first ready health. Each request has a 30 s timeout; a failed request is just another poll, not a crash.

RESULT RULE (demo-result). Env: LIVE_OUTCOME, DEMO_OUTCOME, UPLOAD_OUTCOME (GitHub step outcome strings: "success" | "failure" | "cancelled" | "skipped" | "" when the step didn't run), DEMO_VERSION (may be ""), DEMO_VIDEO_URL (may be ""), DEMO_LOG (path; may not exist), TARGET_REPO (default daveharmswebdev/chess-tutor), GITHUB_SERVER_URL/GITHUB_REPOSITORY/GITHUB_RUN_ID.
- outcome "success" only when all three outcomes are "success" and DEMO_VIDEO_URL is non-empty; otherwise "failure".
- version = DEMO_VERSION if 40-hex, else null; versionUrl = https://github.com/<TARGET_REPO>/commit/<version> or null.
- step: only when DEMO_OUTCOME === "failure": the first `demo stopped at <step>:` in the log (strip ANSI colour codes first; <step> runs up to the first ": " after "at "); else null.
- videoUrl = DEMO_VIDEO_URL when UPLOAD_OUTCOME === "success" and non-empty (also on failure: a partial video is shown), else null.
- run = { label: `Run <GITHUB_RUN_ID>`, url: <server>/<repository>/actions/runs/<id> } (same format as snapshot.ts). Missing run env -> throw (the script only runs in Actions).
- recordedAt = now (ISO).

THE WORKFLOW (coordinator-owned, on branch contract-6, merged in the same PR; do not edit it):
```yaml
# The evening demo video (#6, D-6): waits for the live app to settle on its newest version, runs
# chess-tutor's guided demo against it with video on, stores the video as a public GitHub Release
# asset (one per day, all kept) and records the result in today's snapshot. It doubles as a smoke
# test of the live app, so a failed demo fails this run. Start it by hand with the Run workflow
# button or `pnpm demo`; a manual run replaces today's video under the same asset name.
name: Demo

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "30 0 * * *" # 6:30-7:30 PM US Central, same calendar day as the evening snapshot
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write # commit the snapshot, upload the release asset

concurrency:
  group: snapshot # never races the Snapshot workflow on snapshots/
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  TARGET_REPO: daveharmswebdev/chess-tutor
  RELEASE_TAG: demos

jobs:
  demo:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Today's date
        id: day
        run: echo "date=$(TZ="${DASHBOARD_TZ:-America/Chicago}" date +%F)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Wait for the live version
        id: live
        continue-on-error: true
        run: pnpm exec tsx scripts/demo-wait.ts
        env:
          RENDER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.RENDER_API_KEY }}
          APP_URL: ${{ vars.APP_URL }}

      - name: Check out chess-tutor at the live version
        if: steps.live.outcome == 'success'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: ${{ env.TARGET_REPO }}
          ref: ${{ steps.live.outputs.version }}
          path: chess-tutor
          token: ${{ secrets.DASHBOARD_GH_TOKEN }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Record the demo
        id: record
        if: steps.live.outcome == 'success'
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: chess-tutor
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
          pnpm --filter @chess-tutor/web exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
          pnpm demo 2>&1 | tee "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/demo.log"
        env:
          DEMO_BASE_URL: ${{ vars.APP_URL }}
          DEMO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEMO_TOKEN }}

      - name: Save the video
        id: upload
        if: steps.live.outcome == 'success' && hashFiles('chess-tutor/apps/web/demo-output/demo.webm') != ''
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          set -e
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq ffmpeg > /dev/null
          asset="demo-${{ steps.day.outputs.date }}.mp4"
          ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i chess-tutor/apps/web/demo-output/demo.webm \
            -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart "$asset"
          gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" > /dev/null 2>&1 || \
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" --title "Daily demo videos" \
              --notes "One video of the live chess-tutor app per day, recorded by the Demo workflow."
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber
          echo "url=${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/download/${RELEASE_TAG}/${asset}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Write the demo result
        run: pnpm exec tsx scripts/demo-result.ts demo-result.json
        env:
          LIVE_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.live.outcome }}
          DEMO_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.record.outcome }}
          UPLOAD_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.upload.outcome }}
          DEMO_VERSION: ${{ steps.live.outputs.version }}
          DEMO_VIDEO_URL: ${{ steps.upload.outputs.url }}
          DEMO_LOG: demo.log

      - run: pnpm typecheck
      - name: Build snapshot with the demo
        run: pnpm snapshot
        env:
          DEMO_RESULT_FILE: demo-result.json
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DASHBOARD_GH_TOKEN }}
          RENDER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.RENDER_API_KEY }}
          APP_URL: ${{ vars.APP_URL }}

      - name: Commit snapshot
        run: |
          git config user.name "dashboard-bot"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add snapshots/
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo "No change"; exit 0; fi
          git commit -m "snapshot: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ) (demo)"
          git push

      - name: Fail the run when the demo failed
        if: steps.live.outcome != 'success' || steps.record.outcome != 'success' || steps.upload.outcome != 'success'
        run: |
          echo "The demo did not finish: live=${{ steps.live.outcome }} record=${{ steps.record.outcome }} upload=${{ steps.upload.outcome }}"
          exit 1
```
